definitions.explanation: A bad injury, typically one needing hospital treatment. Used of accidents, falls, and sports injuries; also written {大怪我|おおけが}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧、{大|おお}けが⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{至|いた}らなかった→至る：02009_itaru⟧。
examples.english: Fortunately, it didn't turn into a serious injury.

examples.japanese: ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧{大|おお}けが⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧し、{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}⟦{入院|にゅういん}した→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧。
examples.english: He fell down the stairs, was seriously injured, and spent a month in the hospital.

notes:
From {大|おお} (big) + ⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧ (injury). Usually written with ⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧ in kana, though {大怪我|おおけが} also appears.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}けが⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be seriously injured
- {大|おお}けが⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧: to sustain a serious injury (written style)
- {大|おお}けが⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながる: to lead to a serious injury
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{別状|べつじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大|おお}けが: badly hurt but not life-threatening

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧: injury — the neutral word, any severity
- ⟦{軽傷|けいしょう}→軽傷：16546_keishou⟧: minor injury — the news-report opposite, paired with ⟦{重傷|じゅうしょう}→重傷：14414_juushou⟧ (serious injury)
